template.title: My Education Plan and Profile
template.description: Your plan for this school year: who you are, where you're headed, what you're learning beyond class, and a look back with an adult from your school. Each year builds on the last.
template.instructions: Assign once per school year, to a group or a student. Steps link to the Oregon Education Plan and Profile (EPP) framework by requirement code, so the EPP report fills itself from this work. You can add your own steps: link them to the same requirements and they appear in the same place in the report. Reflection, CRLE and Extended Application steps come back to staff for review.

stages.title: Who I am
stages.milestone: Your strengths, what your assessments showed, and careers you're curious about

steps.title: Show your strengths
steps.description: Add the traits and strengths that fit you best to your portfolio.

steps.title: What my assessments told me
steps.description: Think about the interest or career assessments you took. What fit, and what surprised you?

config.prompt: What did your assessments say about you? What fit, what didn't, and what will you do with it?

steps.title: Careers I'm curious about
steps.description: Find three or more careers or career areas that interest you, and pin your favorites.

config.question: Which careers or career areas would you like to know more about?

stages.title: Where I'm headed
stages.milestone: Goals for after high school and a plan for this year

steps.title: My goals
steps.description: Your goals for after high school, and a few for this year. Big or small, they're yours.

config.prompt: What do you want to be doing after high school? What are your personal goals for this year?

steps.title: My plan after high school
steps.description: What comes after high school for you right now? You can change it any time.

config.question: What's your plan after high school?

steps.title: What it takes to get there
steps.description: What do you need to reach your goals? Think about classes, tests, applications, money and experience.

config.prompt: What will it take to reach your goals: classes, tests, applications, money, experience?

steps.reviewer_guidance:
Do the steps match the goals they wrote?
Are the requirements real for that path (for example, entry tests or prerequisites)?
Suggest one thing they may have missed.

steps.title: This year's action plan
steps.description: List at least three things you'll do this year to move toward your goals.

steps.title: My support network
steps.description: Name at least two people who help you, and how they help: a family member, teacher, coach or mentor.

stages.title: Learning beyond the classroom
stages.milestone: A career-related learning experience and progress on your Extended Application

steps.title: Take part in a career-related learning experience
steps.description: Job shadow, internship, work experience, a career fair, a guest speaker, a service project or a school business. Add proof such as a photo, a sign-in sheet or a link.
steps.reviewer_guidance:
Was it connected to the student's interests or goals?
Record the kind of experience and the host in your comment.

steps.title: Reflect on your experience
steps.description: What did you do, what did you learn, and did it change your goals?

config.prompt: What did you do, what did you learn about the work, and how does it connect to your goals?

steps.reviewer_guidance:
Does it name what they did and what they learned?
Does it connect the experience to their goals?

steps.title: Plan your Extended Application
steps.description: Pick a project that applies what you know to something new and connected to your goals. Say what you'll make and how you'll show it.

config.prompt: What will you do for your Extended Application, how does it connect to your goals, and how will you show your work?

steps.reviewer_guidance:
Does it apply and extend their knowledge in a new and complex situation?
Is it connected to their personal and career interests?
Is it doable this year?

steps.title: Extended Application: collection of evidence
steps.description: Add the work that shows your Extended Application, with a short note on each piece.
steps.reviewer_guidance:
Assess against your school's Extended Application criteria.
Approving records you as the assessor, with the date.

stages.title: Look back and review
stages.milestone: Next year's courses chosen and your yearly review done

steps.title: Plan next year's courses
steps.description: Choose next year's courses with your counselor, thinking about graduation and your goals.
steps.reviewer_guidance:
Do the courses keep them on track for graduation?
Do they fit the student's goals?

steps.title: What I learned and achieved this year
steps.description: Your proudest moments, new skills and anything you'd do differently.

config.prompt: What did you learn and achieve this year, and what are you proudest of?

steps.title: Choose your best work
steps.description: Pick a piece of work from this year that shows what you can do. It goes into your Education Plan and Profile.

steps.title: Yearly review with an adult
steps.description: Meet with your counselor or advisor to look at your plan and your progress toward graduation.
steps.staff_guide: Meet with the student and look over their plan, goals, course plan and progress toward graduation. Mark it done after the meeting. This counts as the annual EPP review.
